description:
Real Check (cv-real-check-v2, free): Estimates whether an image was produced by a generative model rather than captured, without changing it, and says how sure it is. `job.result.verdict` (`generated`, `real`, `uncertain`): Which way the evidence points — an estimate, with `generated_probability` saying how firm. `uncertain` means the image sits between the two lines and a caller should not act on it either way. `real` means none of the signs it knows were found, not that the picture is untouched. A restored or enhanced photograph can read as `generated`, which is right where a model drew its pixels and says nothing about whether the scene happened. `job.result.generated_probability`: The estimated probability that the image was generated, from 0 to 1. `verdict` is this number against fixed lines; read this to draw a stricter or looser one. Stills only: video is announced and not yet in service.

This check changes nothing and costs nothing, so it needs no go-ahead: call it when its answer would help, and say what it found.

Send the image as `input_key`: upload_photo answers with one.

An answer's `job` is the job as the API states it. On a finished job, `usage` is the account as get_usage answers it, and get_usage says what its fields mean.

Most images finish inside this call, with the answer in `job.result`. A slower one answers with `job.status` queued or running: collect it with get_job and `job.id`. Calling this tool again would run the work twice.

input_key.description: The image: the `input_key` upload_photo answered with, or a File ID the user copied from their CraterView.ai workspace.

name: check_real
